Years for money to double (rule of 72)

Source: R/rule_of_72.R
rule_of_72.Rd

A quick estimate: 72 divided by the yearly return in percent. From the Investing basics chapter.

Usage

rule_of_72(annual_return_pct)

Arguments

annual_return_pct

Yearly return as a percent (7 is 7%), not a decimal. Must be greater than 0.

Value

A numeric vector of years.

See also

Other investing basics: future_value(), future_value_series(), real_return()

Examples

rule_of_72(annual_return_pct = 7)
#> [1] 10.28571
